definition.simple: Your equity compared with the margin in use, shown as a percentage. Lower means closer to trouble.
definition.balanced: Margin level = [[equity]] ÷ used [[margin]] × 100%. Brokers use it to decide when to warn you ([[margin-call]]) and when to close trades ([[stop-out]]). The exact levels are set by each broker.

example: Equity 850 USD, used margin 200 USD: margin level = 850 ÷ 200 × 100% = 425%.
